requirements.R-001: PostgreSQL is the authoritative production store; SQLite is single-user local only and production preflight rejects it.
requirements.R-002: Workspaces, projects, memberships, project roles, and repository-level authorization are durable first-class resources.
requirements.R-003: A global human-agent Inbox supports permanent projectless conversations, private Scratchpads, and privacy-preserving legacy migration.
requirements.R-004: The UI becomes project-first while reusing existing thread streaming, message history, files, artifacts, browser, sidecar, and human-input capabilities.
requirements.R-005: DBTL cycles, transitions, gate evaluations, artifacts, approvals, revisions, projection hashes, and reconciliation state are database-authoritative.
requirements.R-006: Human-gated transitions use a durable Review Inbox and cannot be satisfied by agents, schedules, service identities, or replayed approvals.
requirements.R-007: Human members and AI agents form project teams with explicit capabilities, data scopes, budgets, write authority, escalation owners, and audit attribution.
requirements.R-008: The breeding core is crop-neutral; maize is the first reference workflow and uses versioned JSONB or extension tables for crop-specific attributes.
requirements.R-009: Learn output enters Project Working Memory and requires an immutable authorized human promotion into Validated Project Knowledge.
requirements.R-010: Existing run lifecycle, event ordering, streaming, scheduling overlap, thread history, channels, and legacy routes remain compatible.
requirements.R-011: Project, cycle, stage, actor, authorization, reconciliation, cost, accessibility, and operational states are observable and testable.
requirements.R-012: Migrations, configuration, documentation, deployment checks, backfills, rollback, and support diagnostics ship with the implementation.

resolved_builder_proposals.workspace_security: Treat workspace as the collaboration and security boundary. Workspace members may access workspace-visible Inbox threads; project resources additionally require project membership. System administrators manage deployment but receive no implicit project-data access.
resolved_builder_proposals.legacy_visibility: Backfill unassigned legacy threads into the Inbox as private-owner. Sharing or moving to a project is an explicit audited action.
resolved_builder_proposals.agent_write_authority: Agents propose by default. Direct structured-record writes require an assignment capability and remain audited; approvals, knowledge promotion, membership, and authorization-policy changes are human-only.
resolved_builder_proposals.additional_human_gates: Keep the existing GreenAgent design approval, evidence review, and knowledge approval gates. Add human approval for project membership/role changes, knowledge promotion, policy changes, reconciliation imports, and methodological schema-profile changes.
resolved_builder_proposals.knowledge_standard: Promotion requires a project reviewer, source and version provenance, scope, limitations, producing run, evidence grade, and an immutable authorization event.
resolved_builder_proposals.reconciliation_policy: Retry projection refresh three times with bounded backoff, then set reconciliation_blocked and alert project owners plus workspace administrators. Only project owners or designated reconciliation operators may rebuild the projection from PostgreSQL.
resolved_builder_proposals.maize_v1_boundary: Start with generic germplasm, pedigree, cross, population, site, season, environment, trial, plot, trait, observation, and selection records. Keep heterotic group, maturity group, inbred/hybrid class, and maize-specific trait metadata in a validated maize-v1 extension document.

phases.objective: Freeze the database-authority, authorization, API, event, migration, and reconciliation contracts before feature code changes.
prerequisites: Current backend and frontend test suites passing
A clean inventory of user-owned changes before implementation
dry_lab_actions: Add cross-component contracts for workspace/project roles, conversation scope, DBTL synchronization states, actor envelopes, knowledge lifecycle, and maize-v1 extension metadata.
Write migration and compatibility tests first for nullable project/workspace associations, legacy threads, active runs, and scheduled tasks.
Define repository and API error semantics for forbidden, missing, revision conflict, active-run conflict, and reconciliation-blocked states.
Add a production preflight contract that rejects SQLite when production or multi-user mode is enabled.
Document the authoritative PostgreSQL and temporary .greenagent adapter boundary in root and module AGENTS documentation.
inputs: Existing migration, authorization, run, and thread tests
outputs: Versioned JSON contracts and TypeScript/Python types
self_checks: Contract fixtures parse in Python and TypeScript.
No application runtime module imports .greenagent paths directly.
Compatibility tests capture current thread ordering, active-run, scheduled-overlap, and legacy-route behavior.
Documentation states PostgreSQL authority and the SQLite production prohibition consistently.
tester_handoff: Contract fixtures with expected valid and invalid examples
Baseline outputs for existing thread, run, and scheduler invariants
phases.rollback: Remove only the new contract fixtures, documentation, and failing-first tests; no runtime or schema state exists yet.

phases.objective: Create the authoritative workspace/project collaboration core and enforce membership at repository and API boundaries.
prerequisites: Migration head and create_all parity tests understood
dry_lab_actions: Add ORM models, repositories, Alembic migration, and registration for workspaces, workspace_members, projects, project_members, project_agent_assignments, decisions, approvals, and activity_events.
Add project_id and workspace_id nullable associations to threads_meta, runs, scheduled_tasks, and relevant event/artifact metadata without breaking legacy rows.
Implement project-scoped authorization helpers that compose system authentication, workspace membership, project membership, and object ownership.
Add CRUD APIs for workspaces, projects, memberships, roles, and agent assignments with audit events.
Add production configuration preflight for PostgreSQL and explicit SQLite local limitations.
Add indexes and uniqueness constraints for membership, slugs, project status, project-scoped active work, and audit lookup.
inputs: Gateway authz and dependency injection seams
Existing UserRow, ThreadMetaRow, RunRow, AgentRow, and ScheduledTaskRow
self_checks: Fresh create_all and Alembic upgrade produce equivalent schemas.
Cross-workspace and cross-project reads and writes fail closed.
Legacy rows with null workspace/project associations remain readable only under legacy rules.
Every mutation emits an actor-attributed activity event.
Production startup rejects SQLite while local single-user startup remains supported.
tester_handoff: Migration upgrade/downgrade fixtures for SQLite local and PostgreSQL production
RBAC matrix covering every workspace and project role
Cross-tenant negative tests and audit-event fixtures
phases.rollback: Disable the feature flag, keep new tables and nullable columns intact, and route traffic through legacy thread ownership. Downgrade is permitted only before any workspace/project production data is created.

phases.objective: Introduce a safe global human-agent Inbox, private Scratchpads, project conversations, and reversible legacy-thread classification.
prerequisites: Existing thread search, history, create, rename, delete, and path helpers mapped
dry_lab_actions: Add scope_type, visibility, workspace_id, and nullable project_id to the thread metadata API and query layer.
Backfill legacy user threads idempotently as inbox/private-owner without changing message history or event sequence.
Add explicit audited operations to share an Inbox thread, make a private Scratchpad, move a thread into a project, or remove a project association back to Inbox when policy permits.
Extend thread creation, listing, search, branching, sidecars, schedules, channels, files, and export to preserve conversation scope.
Add workspace-agent participation rules and prevent project agents from entering workspace Inbox unless separately assigned at workspace scope.
Preserve existing /workspace/chats routes as compatibility redirects resolved through scope-aware path helpers.
inputs: Existing thread metadata and LangGraph thread APIs
Existing recent-chat, channel, sidecar, scheduler, and file-link behavior
outputs: Global Inbox and Scratchpad backend queries
self_checks: Legacy threads remain private and retain canonical event ordering.
Moving or sharing a thread is explicit, authorized, audited, and idempotent.
Projectless conversations continue to stream, schedule, branch, export, and use sidecars.
A project agent cannot access workspace Inbox without workspace assignment.
Old URLs resolve without redirect loops or remount-related stream loss.
tester_handoff: Legacy backfill fixtures and rerun-idempotency evidence
Conversation scope and visibility authorization matrix
Streaming and history regression results for every scope
phases.rollback: Disable Inbox routing and continue resolving legacy URLs; retain scope metadata as ignored nullable fields. Never reverse a user's explicit share or project move automatically.

phases.objective: Make Projects and Inbox the primary workspace while reusing the stable chat and operational components.
prerequisites: Frontend route and query contracts generated
dry_lab_actions: Change /workspace from a chat redirect to the project portfolio.
Add /workspace/inbox and nested /workspace/projects/[project_id] routes for Overview, DBTL, Work, Materials, Trials, Data, Knowledge, Team, Activity, Settings, and Sessions.
Refactor the sidebar into global workspace navigation plus selected-project navigation, keeping one clear accent and avoiding dashboard-card mosaics.
Reuse MessageList, InputBox, ChatBox, files, artifacts, browser, sidecar, goals, todos, and streaming hooks inside Inbox and project sessions.
Reuse project-folder candidates and FileTreePanel for project creation and a full-page Files/Project storage surface.
Add project portfolio, empty/loading/error/offline states, project switcher, global search entry, and responsive/mobile navigation.
Add TanStack Query domains and invalidation rules for workspaces, projects, memberships, Inbox threads, and project summaries.
inputs: Existing WorkspaceContent, WorkspaceSidebar, ChatPage, ChatBox, FileTreePanel, and query provider
outputs: Responsive project Files and Overview surfaces
self_checks: A user can reach Inbox or a project without entering a new chat.
Existing streams do not remount or lose state when thread IDs are created.
Headings and labels alone communicate project status and available actions.
Keyboard, screen-reader, mobile, reduced-motion, offline, loading, empty, and error states are covered.
Frontend check, unit tests, and mocked Playwright flows pass.
tester_handoff: Prototype orientation-task fixtures for H0/H1 evaluation
phases.rollback: Restore the /workspace legacy redirect and old sidebar behind a feature flag while retaining new routes for direct access.

phases.objective: Move DBTL product state into PostgreSQL, isolate GreenAgent behind temporary adapters, and expose durable human review plus blocked reconciliation.
prerequisites: Approved DBTL contracts and existing GreenAgent CLI adapter tests
dry_lab_actions: Add DBTL cycle, transition intent, gate evaluation, artifact, review, and synchronization ORM models, repositories, migrations, and APIs.
Implement DBTLPolicyEvaluator and DBTLProjectionAdapter interfaces; keep .greenagent access inside the temporary adapter only.
Implement monotonic db_revision, canonical projection hash, idempotency keys, optimistic expected-revision checks, and transactional transition commits.
Implement post-commit projection refresh, three bounded retries, mismatch detection, reconciliation_blocked, owner/operator alerts, and database-led rebuild.
Persist complete policy input/output, GreenAgent version, artifact hashes, actor, authorization, and activity events.
Prevent agents, schedules, service identities, and replayed authorization references from satisfying human gates.
Build project DBTL lifecycle, durable Review Inbox, evidence/artifact diff, transition actions, and Reconciliation blocked inspector.
Emit stage lifecycle through task_* events and attach project/cycle/stage/revision metadata to tracing.
inputs: Existing dbtl orchestrator and GreenAgent CLI wrapper
RunManager, RunEventStore, human-input protocol, Console API, notifications, and tracing callbacks
outputs: Policy, concurrency, failure-injection, and authorization tests
self_checks: A committed PostgreSQL revision is never overwritten by a stale file.
Every injected write failure reaches the specified synchronization state.
Further transitions stop while reconciliation_blocked but read-only history remains available.
Projection deletion and corruption are repaired only from PostgreSQL.
Human approvals are identity-bound, single-use, and immutable.
DBTL stage events and traces include project, cycle, stage, and revision.
tester_handoff: State-machine transition table and human-gate matrix
Failure-injection cases for each transition write step
Review Inbox accessibility and authorization cases
phases.rollback: Disable database-driven DBTL execution and leave persisted cycles read-only. Do not re-promote .greenagent to authority; operate the legacy DBTL run target only in explicit development mode until repaired.

phases.objective: Turn human members and AI agents into an auditable project team with scoped work, automation, notifications, and activity.
prerequisites: B4 DBTL review and transition APIs
dry_lab_actions: Add project Team UI for humans and reusable agent assignments.
Enforce assignment capabilities for allowed tools, data scopes, writable object types, budgets, active dates, autonomy, and escalation owner.
Default agents to propose-only; require explicit assignment capability for direct structured-record writes.
Add durable project work items, comments, decisions, mentions, and activity views using actor envelopes.
Add project_id, cycle_id, and work_item_id to schedules while preserving the existing run lifecycle and overlap index guarantees.
Route pending gates and handoffs through existing notification and channel mechanisms with explicit Inbox/project routing.
Filter Console API reporting by workspace/project and expose run, token, model, cost, failure, and agent-stage summaries.
inputs: Project membership and agent assignment models
Existing AgentRow/config, scheduler, channels, Console API, notifications, and run metadata
outputs: Project work, decisions, comments, mentions, and activity
self_checks: Agent capability and data-scope denials fail closed.
Every work, decision, automation, and notification event has actor and run attribution.
Scheduled runs pause at human gates and never approve them.
Existing scheduled overlap and active-run database constraints remain atomic.
Project reports exclude unauthorized projects and include DBTL correlation identifiers.
tester_handoff: Scheduler gate and overlap concurrency cases
phases.rollback: Disable Team mutations and project-aware automation while retaining assignments and activity as read-only audit data. Fall back to user-owned custom agents without widening access.

phases.objective: Add authoritative crop-neutral breeding records and validate the extension mechanism against a maize reference workflow.
prerequisites: Approved maize-v1 Builder proposal remains within the generic-core boundary
dry_lab_actions: Add project-scoped ORM models, repositories, migrations, and APIs for germplasm, pedigree edges, crosses, populations, sites, seasons, environments, trials, plots, traits, observations, and selections.
Add immutable source/import metadata, record revisions, supersession, validation status, and actor/run attribution.
Define a versioned extension-document contract and maize-v1 JSON Schema for heterotic group, maturity group, inbred/hybrid class, and maize trait metadata.
Add CSV/API ingestion staging, validation reports, duplicate detection, partial-failure handling, and explicit commit.
Add Materials, Trials, and Data project views using dense tables, filters, relationship navigation, validation status, and context inspectors.
Seed synthetic maize reference fixtures only; do not import private research data.
inputs: Project RBAC and agent write capabilities
outputs: Authoritative generic breeding schema and APIs
self_checks: All records require project authorization and provenance.
Pedigree cycles and invalid cross/population relationships are rejected.
Wrong-version or invalid maize extensions fail with field-level diagnostics.
Ingestion preview cannot mutate authoritative records.
Synthetic maize workflow can progress from germplasm through selection with full attribution.
phases.rollback: Disable breeding-record mutations and keep imported records read-only. Never delete authoritative records during rollback; supersede invalid imports through audited remediation.

phases.objective: Implement permission-filtered project knowledge with a strict Working Memory to human-approved Validated Knowledge promotion pipeline.
prerequisites: B6 authoritative breeding records and provenance
dry_lab_actions: Add knowledge source, document, chunk, claim, link, retrieval event, Working Memory, promotion review, supersession, and retraction models and migrations.
Implement source ingestion with project/data-use scope, document version, checksum, parser status, and citation locations.
Implement permission filtering before full-text ranking; keep embedding retrieval behind an optional interface.
Write Learn-stage output only to provisional Project Working Memory with producing run, agent, sources, limitations, and evidence grade.
Add a dedicated identity-bound promotion command that creates an immutable review event and Validated Project Knowledge version.
Default authoritative retrieval to validated knowledge plus structured records; require explicit opt-in and warning labels for Working Memory.
Build Knowledge sources, Working Memory review queue, Validated Knowledge, citation, supersession, retraction, and insufficient-evidence UI.
inputs: Existing personal memory backend and API as a separation boundary
Project review and actor authorization infrastructure
outputs: Working Memory and promotion review pipeline
self_checks: Learn-stage runs cannot create validated records.
Promotion is reviewer-authorized, single-purpose, immutable, and evidence-versioned.
Permission filtering occurs before ranking or generation.
Every answer has source/version citations or returns insufficient evidence.
Personal memory never appears in project knowledge without explicit reviewed import.
Superseded and retracted knowledge is excluded from default retrieval.
phases.rollback: Disable project knowledge generation and retrieval while retaining sources, Working Memory, and review records read-only. Never downgrade Working Memory into personal memory or promote it during rollback.

phases.objective: Prove safe migration, operational recovery, accessibility, performance, and end-to-end behavior before the workspace-first experience becomes the default.
prerequisites: B1 through B7 implemented and self-tested
Approved rollback runbook and support-bundle redaction rules
dry_lab_actions: Run idempotent backfills for workspace defaults, private Inbox legacy threads, project links, project-aware runs/schedules, and database-derived GreenAgent projections.
Add startup and periodic reconciliation observability, alerts, support-bundle fields, and operator runbooks.
Run full backend, frontend, migration, blocking-IO, E2E, accessibility, concurrency, failure-injection, and authorization suites.
Measure project portfolio, Inbox, DBTL timeline, breeding tables, and knowledge search against defined latency and scale targets.
Run current-versus-project-first orientation study fixtures for H0/H1 and record limitations without interpreting scientific outcomes.
Update README, root/module AGENTS, configuration examples, install/doctor/support guidance, and release notes.
Keep the old workspace redirect and sidebar behind a release rollback flag until migration and acceptance evidence are approved.
outputs: Updated documentation and release rollback controls
self_checks: Backfills are idempotent and never broaden legacy visibility.
Database/projection mismatch is detectable and recoverable after restart.
All required test commands pass with no undocumented skips.
Workspace-first routes meet accessibility and agreed latency targets.
Support artifacts expose revisions and errors without credentials or private research data.
Documentation matches implemented configuration, architecture, and rollback.
tester_handoff: Complete changed-file and requirement traceability matrix
Self-test command outputs and environment description
Known limitations and implementation drift report
phases.rollback: Disable workspace-first default routing and all mutation feature flags, retain new data read-only, continue legacy chat operations, and repair forward. Do not downgrade production schemas after irreversible user data exists.

cross_phase_rules: Backend features and bug fixes are test-driven; write failing tests before implementation.
No phase begins until prerequisites and prior self-checks pass.
Any methodological, authorization, data-use, wet-lab, or scope drift is recorded and routed to its required human gate.
Each migration supports create_all parity, Alembic upgrade, legacy data, and production PostgreSQL.
Every user-facing change updates README and every architecture change updates the relevant AGENTS file.
No private research data is introduced; maize fixtures are synthetic until separately approved.
Builder does not interpret scientific results or approve its own output.
human_input_needed: Cross-check and approve this phased action plan before the cycle transitions from build-planning to building.
Confirm that the resolved Builder proposals remain within the approved design or request specific changes.
Authorize project-file mutation for implementation after plan approval.
